note: SGSM3-associated intellectual disability cohorts report behavioral manifestations including irritability and behavioral disturbances, making high frequency plausible.

evidence.text: SGSM3 was identified as a candidate gene for autosomal recessive intellectual disability in families with clinical manifestations of intellectual disability and neurodevelopmental findings.

source.title: A Strong Candidate Gene for Nonsyndromic Intellectual Disability Phenotype: SGSM3
source.quote: In this study, a novel homozygous stop-gain (NM_015705.6: c.1576C>T: p.(Arg526Ter)) variation was detected in the SGSM3 gene in two siblings with short stature and ID findings.

evidence.text: A homozygous founder variant in SGSM3 was described segregating with intellectual disability in Ashkenazi Jewish families.

source.title: Intellectual disability syndrome associated with a homozygous founder variant in SGSM3 in Ashkenazi Jews
